blocks.text: SINGAPORE – Two men are set to be charged on Oct 14 after they allegedly stole bank cards from passengers’ bags on a flight from Vietnam’s Ho Chi Minh City to Singapore. In a statement on Oct 13, the police said the two Chinese nationals – aged 54 and 59 – were involved in two separate cases of theft on board an aircraft. Officers from the Airport Police Division conducted an operation at Changi Airport Terminal 4 at about 9:45 am on Oct 12.
